name: The H Ai K U Method
description: H·AI·K·U (Human + AI Knowledge Unification) is a lifecycle orchestrator for structured AI-assisted work. Instead of loading instructions into the agent's context, H·AI·K·U drip-feeds one action at a time from a plan kept on disk — so runs survive context compaction, /clear, crashes, and even handoffs between humans. 24 built-in studios cover software, marketing, security, compliance, incident response, data pipelines, and more. Each stage has configurable autonomy (auto-advance, human review, or external sign-off), parallel adversarial review agents, and deterministic quality gates. The agent stays simple; the orchestrator holds the structure.
longDescription:
Ships **31 skills**, **2 hooks** and **2 MCP servers**.

- **Skills** (31): `haiku-adopt` (Reverse-engineer an existing feature into H·AI·K·U intent artifacts), `haiku-archive` (Archive an intent — soft-hide it from default lists while preserving all state), `haiku-autopilot` (Full autonomous workflow — elaborate, plan, build, review, and deliver in one command), `haiku-backlog` (Parking lot for ideas not ready for planning — add, list, review, or promote), `haiku-capacity` (Historical throughput — bolt counts, stage durations, patterns), `haiku-change-mode` (Change the execution mode of an active H·AI·K·U intent — dial up or dial back human involvement mid-flight), `haiku-changelog` (Show the project changelog / release notes), `haiku-composite` (Create a composite intent combining stages from multiple studios with sync points), and 23 more
- **Hooks** (2): `PreToolUse`, `PostToolUse`
- **MCP servers** (2): `haiku`, `haiku-playwright`

Installs with `claude plugin install the-h-ai-k-u-method@claude-community` from `gigsmart/haiku-method` (`plugin`).
